title: Advanced Verbal Adverbs
description: Complex verbal adverb usage and style
intro: Advanced verbal adverb (деепричастие) usage involves nuanced choices. IMPERFECTIVE (-я/-а): simultaneous action: Читая книгу, он пил чай. PERFECTIVE (-в/-вши): prior completed action: Прочитав книгу, он лёг спать. SAME SUBJECT RULE: Both actions must have the same subject - violation is a common error! STYLE: Verbal adverbs are formal/written; colloquial Russian uses когда/после того как instead. POSITION: Usually before main clause, but can follow for variety.
rules: Imperfective (-я/-а) = simultaneous: Работая, он слушал музыку
Perfective (-в/-вши) = prior action: Закончив работу, он ушёл
SAME SUBJECT required: *Читая книгу, зазвонил телефон (ERROR!)
Formal style — colloquial prefers: когда читал, после того как прочитал
examples: Гуляя по парку, мы встретили друзей. (While walking in the park, we met friends.)
Узнав новость, она обрадовалась. (Having learned the news, she was happy.)
ERROR: *Подходя к дому, начался дождь. (Different subjects!)
CORRECT: Когда я подходил к дому, начался дождь.

items.prompt: _____ книгу, он пил кофе. (While reading - simultaneous)
items.promptEnglish: While reading a book, he drank coffee.

items.prompt: _____ работу, она пошла домой. (Having finished, prior)
items.promptEnglish: Having finished work, she went home.
Which sentence follows the same-subject rule?
items.hint: Same subject: мы гуляли, мы встретили
items.explanation: Same subject: мы гуляли и встретили.

items.prompt: _____ в Москву, он сразу позвонил. (Having arrived)
items.promptEnglish: Having arrived in Moscow, he immediately called.
While listening to music, she danced.

items.prompt: Fix the error: *Читая газету, зазвонил телефон.
items.promptEnglish: Fix: While reading the newspaper, the phone rang.
options: Когда я читал газету, зазвонил телефон.
items.answer: Когда я читал газету, зазвонил телефон.

items.promptEnglish: Having checked the documents, sign here.

items.prompt: Colloquial alternative to 'Прочитав книгу, он понял':
items.promptEnglish: After reading the book, he understood.
options: После того как он прочитал книгу, он понял.
items.answer: После того как он прочитал книгу, он понял.

items.prompt: _____ о проблеме, мы нашли решение. (Having thought)
items.promptEnglish: Having thought about the problem, we found a solution.

items.prompt: _____ на вопрос, он улыбнулся. (Having answered — prior completed action)
items.promptEnglish: Having answered the question, he smiled.
items.explanation: He answered first, then smiled: perfective ответив.

items.prompt: _____ по телефону, она записывала адрес. (While talking — simultaneous)
items.promptEnglish: While talking on the phone, she was writing down the address.
items.explanation: Both actions happened at the same time: imperfective разговаривая.

fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Prior completed action: perfective verbal adverb
hints: The action of hearing happened first and was completed before she started crying. Which verbal adverb form expresses a completed prior action?
explanations: Perfective verbal adverbs (ending in -в/-вши) express completed actions that happened before the main verb: 'Услышав новость' (Having heard the news) happened before 'заплакала' (she cried).
